_note: The GitHub feed driven against live GitHub through the real composition root, with an in-memory database, the mock Discord transport and an injected clock. COUNTS, statuses and booleans only: no title, login, sha, url or message text. The issue and commit cursors were pre-seeded to simulate a watch that started earlier, so real, existing items count as new; that is a simulation of WHEN the watch began, not a live observation of a new event.
